content.title: Beta inks $1B deal with Eve Air Mobility, Estée Lauder's AI chatbot
content.description:
Market Domination host Josh Lipton tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including Beta Technologies (BETA) striking a $1 billion, ten-year deal with Eve Air Mobility, media giants Netflix (NFLX), Paramount Skydance (PSKY), and Comcast (CMCSA) placing their latest bids for Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD), and Estée Lauder (EL) revealing their AI chatbot for helping choose fragrances.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.
